rows.note: For an everyday craving or urge, this is the all-purpose spoken choice.

example.english: I get a craving for late-night food as soon as I finish work.
example.traditional: 我一收工就有食宵夜嘅心癮。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 sau1 gung1 zau6 jau5 sik6 siu1 je2 ge3 sam1 jan5

rows.note: Use this when the craving is specifically for food, drink, or smoking.

example.english: I get a craving for a cigarette after a meal.
example.traditional: 我食完飯唔食支煙就有口癮。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 faan6 m4 sik6 zi1 jin1 zau6 jau5 hau2 jan5

rows.note: Use this for broad, intense yearning rather than a bodily or addictive urge.

example.english: Their craving for freedom made them determined to leave that place.
example.traditional: 佢對自由嘅渴望，令佢決心離開嗰個地方。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zi6 jau4 ge3 hot3 mong6 ling6 keoi5 kyut3 sam1 lei4 hoi1 go2 go3 dei6 fong1
